title: School Subjects
intro: What do you learn at school?

parentTip.vi: Hỏi con hôm nay học môn gì: "What did you have at school today? Which subject do you like best?"
parentTip.say: Which subject do you like best?

gaps.s: I love ___. I draw and paint in every lesson.
In ___ we learn about kings and queens from long ago.

text.title: My School Day
lines: On Mondays, we have maths first. It's my favourite subject.
After break, we have science. Today we looked at insects.
In history, Mr Green told us about a famous queen.
On Fridays, we have art and music, so Friday is a fun day!

questions.q: What is the writer's favourite subject?
What did they look at in science?
Why is Friday a fun day?
